send_sms.name: Send SMS
send_sms.description: Send an SMS message to a SIM card.

device_id.name: SIM Card
device_id.description: The SIM card to send the SMS to

read_sms.name: Read SMS
read_sms.description: Read SMS messages from a SIM card.

device_id.name: SIM Card
device_id.description: The SIM card to read SMS from

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of messages to retrieve

reset_connection.name: Reset connection
reset_connection.description: Reset the SIM card connection, cancelling the current data session.

device_id.name: SIM Card
device_id.description: The SIM card whose connection to reset

set_autodisable.name: Set auto-disable date
set_autodisable.description: Schedule a date on which the SIM card is automatically disabled, or clear it.

date.name: Auto-disable date
date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the future. Leave empty to clear.

set_usage_limits.name: Set usage limits
set_usage_limits.description: Configure the data and SMS usage thresholds for a SIM card.

data_threshold.name: Data threshold (bytes)
data_threshold.description: Data usage limit in bytes. Omit to leave unchanged.

sms_threshold.name: SMS threshold
sms_threshold.description: SMS usage limit (number of messages). Omit to leave unchanged.

auto_enable.name: Auto re-enable monthly
auto_enable.description: Automatically re-enable the SIM at the start of each month.

set_rateplan.name: Set rate plan
set_rateplan.description: Assign a rate plan to a SIM card.

plan_id.name: Plan ID
plan_id.description: The identifier of the rate plan to assign.
